prompt: You are learning a new type of algebra problem. Which sequence is most likely to build real understanding?

options.text: Study a worked example, cover the solution, then try a similar problem yourself
Jump straight to the hardest exam questions you can find
Watch the teacher solve ten problems without trying any yourself
Memorise the formulas on their own, without any examples

explanation: A worked example shows the method clearly, and immediately trying a similar problem yourself — without looking — is what turns watching into being able to do it.
